environment.description: ASP.NET Core 6.0 service deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier). Split Proxy sidecar running on localhost:3141 returning treatment 'legacy' for the xml-parsing-mode split. Default config XmlParsing:DefaultMode is set to 'legacy' in appsettings.json. No network egress restrictions. Service has read access to Azure Key Vault and local filesystem.
